en.name: Styanax Voidshell Skin

zh.description: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。
zh.name: Styanax 虚空之壳外观

en.description: The Tales of Duviri tell of the Gynfas Kaithe visiting homes on a moonless night. To deny it entry is to invite dire misfortune. A fitting steed for Dagath Yfari.
en.name: Gynfas Kaithe

zh.description: 《双衍王境故事集》讲述了画布绝灵骥会在无月之夜造访各家各户。将它拒之门外会招致可怕的厄运。它是 Dagath 伊法里的最佳坐骑。
zh.name: 画布绝灵骥

en.description: The macabre light of the Gynfas Kaithe’s tail has haunted many a moor and battlefield.
en.name: Gynfas Tail

zh.description: 画布绝灵骥尾巴上那阴森的光芒，曾萦绕许多荒野和战场。
zh.name: 画布马尾

en.description: Forewarn that fury awaits anyone who challenges your Kaithe and its rider.
en.name: Vexage Coronet

zh.description: 事先警告，对于任何挑战你的绝灵骥和它的骑手的人，愤怒在等待着他们。
zh.name: 忿火马冠

en.description: A skilled rider repurposes the Void’s mark for their Kaithe.
en.name: Dauntair Coronet

zh.description: 一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。
zh.name: 悚飒马冠

en.description: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
en.name: Myrthen Coronet

zh.description: 欢乐在欢馨马冠中开花。
zh.name: 欢馨马冠

en.description: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
en.name: Enverve Coronet

zh.description: 激妒马冠优雅地传达了一种苦涩的情感。
zh.name: 激妒马冠

en.description: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
en.name: Wistfall Coronet

zh.description: 忧泣马冠展示了忧郁之美。
zh.name: 忧泣马冠

en.description: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
en.name: Aetigo Kaithe

zh.description: 因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的青翠平原，但当岛屿化为灰烬之时，它们的眼睛也随之消逝。
zh.name: 因理绝灵骥

en.description: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
en.name: Psyacus Kaithe

zh.description: 心道绝灵骥会在懦夫的心中唤起恐惧。双衍王境的民众普遍认为，那些骑上心道绝灵骥的人要么勇敢，要么无情。
zh.name: 心道绝灵骥

en.description: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
en.name: Histornam Kaithe

zh.description: 有言说伟大的士魂大帝最喜史源绝灵骥，胜于其他的所有品种。正是在一匹史源的背上，士魂大帝本人学会了骑乘。
zh.name: 史源绝灵骥

en.description: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron's sharp horns.
en.name: Sviari Chamfron

zh.description: 绝灵骥骑手的力量表现在瑞豚马盔的锋利之角上。
zh.name: 瑞豚马盔

en.description: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
en.name: Dyrncaul Chamfron

zh.description: 勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。
zh.name: 勇角马盔

en.description: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
en.name: Irdeni Chamfron

zh.description: 复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。
zh.name: 复斓马盔

en.description: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
en.name: Kheyur Chamfron

zh.description: 华金马盔适合任何正式场合。
zh.name: 华金马盔

en.description: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
en.name: Dovin Saddle

zh.description: 迹语石马鞍深沉的曲线和轻巧的结构使得绝灵骥兼具良好的平衡性和易于与骑手交流。
zh.name: 迹语石马鞍

en.description: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
en.name: Vaidurian Saddle

zh.description: 猫睛石马鞍舒适坚固的设计非常适合长时间骑乘绝灵骥。
zh.name: 猫睛石马鞍

en.description: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
en.name: Sohseki Saddle

zh.description: 杀生石马鞍兼具酷炫与舒适的特性。它的填充物在跳跃过程中具备很好的稳定性和保护性。
zh.name: 杀生石马鞍

en.description: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
en.name: Caersid Tail

zh.description: 战坞马尾彰显着复仇战士的精神。
zh.name: 战坞马尾

en.description: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
en.name: Heoro Tail

zh.description: 拥有荣英马尾的绝灵骥召唤出荣耀。
zh.name: 荣英马尾

en.description: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
en.name: Velific Tail

zh.description: 用灵现马尾装饰优雅的绝灵骥的动作。
zh.name: 灵现马尾

en.description: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
en.name: Aebolg Tail

zh.description: 骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。
zh.name: 骨棘马尾

en.description: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.

zh.name: 漂泊者 Dex 头罩

en.name: Drifter Keeler Hood

zh.description: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。
zh.name: 漂泊者凯勒头罩

en.name: Drifter Grineer Hood

zh.description: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵面罩和兜帽深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。
zh.name: 漂泊者 Grineer 头罩

en.description: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
en.name: Ceno Helmet

zh.description: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。
zh.name: 赛诺头盔

en.description: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
en.name: Vahd Mask

zh.name: 瓦德面具

en.name: Zauba Mask

zh.name: 佐巴面具

en.description: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
en.name: Grunge Hood

zh.name: 颓废风头罩

en.description: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
en.name: Outrider Mask

zh.description: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。
zh.name: 侦查员面罩

en.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
en.name: Emissary Hood

zh.description: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。
zh.name: 使徒头罩

en.description: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
en.name: Haztech Mask

zh.description: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。
zh.name: 危难技工面罩

en.description: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
en.name: Smelter Mask

zh.description: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。
zh.name: 冶炼技工面罩

en.description: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
en.name: Vent Rat Mask

zh.description: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。
zh.name: 通风鼠面罩

Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.
